problem:
Let
$E=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -1 \\ \frac{3}{2}\end{aligned}]$
and
$R=[\begin{aligned}-1 & \sqrt{3} & 1\end{aligned}].$
What are the dimensions of $ER?$
worked_solution:
We notice that $E$ is a $3\times 1$ matrix and $R$ is a $1\times 3$ matrix. 

There is $1$ column in $E$ and $1$ row in $R.$ Since the number of columns in $E$ equals the number of rows in $R,$ the matrices $E$ and $R$ are conformable for multiplication. 

The product $ER$ has dimensions $3\times 3:$

$$
{E}_{3\times \boxed{\text{1}}}{\times }_{✓}{R}_{\boxed{\text{1}}\times 3}={ER}_{3\times 3}
$$
